read_only: This device can't manage cloud servers.
bad_request: That request can't be sent to a cloud server.
no_provider: No installed extension offers that cloud provider.
not_bound: {machine} isn't linked to a cloud server.
already_bound: That server is already linked to {machine}.
rebound: {machine} was linked to another server meanwhile: nothing has been asked of it.
confirmation_required: Confirm first: nothing has been asked of the server.
acknowledgement_required: Enter the server's ID to confirm: nothing has been asked of the server.
unsupported: This server can't do that right now.
not_signed_in: {name} isn't signed in. Check the extension's settings.
invalid_state: The server can't do that in the state it's in.
rate_limited: {name} is being asked too often. Try again in a moment.
capacity: {name} has no capacity for that right now. Try again later.
provider_off: {name} is turned off. Turn it on in Extensions.
not_running: {name} isn't running. Turn it on in Extensions and try again.
not_provided: {name} doesn't manage cloud servers in this version. Update the extension.
bad_answer: {name} gave an answer Persona can't use.
deadline: {name} took too long to answer. Try again.
no_database: Cloud server links need the hub's database.
store_failed: Couldn't read or save the cloud server links.
recovery_start_timeout: The server didn't start in time.
recovery_stopped: Persona stopped following the start. Refresh to see the server's state.
recovery_no_reconnect: The server is running, but Persona can't reconnect {machine} from here.
recovery_offline: The server is running, but {machine} didn't reconnect in time. Try Reconnect.
card_destructive: Destructive action on cloud server {instance} of {machine}: {action}. Unsaved work on it may be lost.
card_reconnect: Persona reconnects {machine} once the server runs.
action_hard_reset: Hard reset, without shutting the system down
action_force_stop: Force power off, without shutting the system down
